finding: CF-A-FINISH-TOKEN-IS-ONE-TOKEN (Drew, 2026-09-07). 14951 card_catalog rows sit on a NON-CANONICAL Pokemon finish token. The canonical tokens are 'holofoil' and 'reverse-holofoil', chosen by the mint-lane vocabulary (scripts/lib/pokemon-finish-vocab.cjs, #1935) and confirmed by source: the checklist-side scrape 'pokemon-tcg-data-scraped-2026-08-14' already spells them that way (27,559 reverse-holofoil + 12,039 holofoil), while every non-canonical spelling is ingest-auto-seed or sales-attested. RETIRE where the canonical twin already exists (the checklist/attested twin wins); RESLUG where the address is vacant. Graded children follow their parent row and are never given their own entry.
note: Occupied destinations adjudicated against the tcgdex checklist and prod point reads: every occupant is the SAME card under a fuller spelling. Folds converted from reslug to retire; rows whose SEED side carries the fuller checklist name are withheld to the collisions report rather than retired.
